Home.description: Senior full stack software engineer with 5+ years of experience building scalable products from scratch for global teams, across healthcare, education, SaaS and e-commerce.

Projects.subtitle: The four projects I'm proudest of, and what each one achieved.

wiggle.title: Wiggle
wiggle.description: Multi-tenant SaaS for veterinary groups: POS, treatment plans, invoicing, CRM and payments in one platform, delivered as a web app, a browser extension and online bill pay.
wiggle.achievement_1: **$2M+ processed every month** across 15+ clinics and 5,000+ transactions.
wiggle.achievement_2: The only developer, working with the CTO, CEO and a QA, from the first commit.
wiggle.achievement_3: A self-service portal reduced admin tickets, and AI-assisted plan ingestion sped up onboarding.

phew.title: Phew.ai
phew.description: AI content intelligence: personalized article feeds become ready-to-publish social posts in the brand's own voice.
phew.achievement_1: **500+ articles an hour** through the pipeline, with batching, retries and automatic fallback.
phew.achievement_2: Led development and set the technical standards for a global team.
phew.achievement_3: Mentored contributors while balancing performance, cost and maintainability.

bizzidb.title: Bizzi DB
bizzidb.description: A private desktop workspace for PostgreSQL and MySQL: browse data, design schemas and run SQL, all on your machine.
bizzidb.achievement_1: Created and maintain it as **open source (MIT)** for macOS, Windows and Linux.
bizzidb.achievement_2: Local-only by design: no account, no cloud, passwords can live in the system keychain.
bizzidb.achievement_3: Reviewed changes, schema diagrams and a SQL editor with query plans in one workspace.

sltreinos.title: SL Treinos
sltreinos.description: A coach dashboard and a student app on one backend, so trainers spend their time coaching instead of calculating.
sltreinos.achievement_1: **About 70% less manual work** for the consultancy.
sltreinos.achievement_2: Automatic volume calculation and load adjustment for every student.
sltreinos.achievement_3: Students log every set in the app, so coaches plan from real history.
